_readme: Phase R4 golden set for `npm run eval:rag`. Four buckets. Each entry: a query and one or more `expect` clauses (fromContains / subjectContains, case-insensitive). An entry HITS if any expect clause matches any result in top-k. The `paraphrase` bucket is the decision slice for R5 (hybrid pgvector): if it clears the bar after R1-R3, skip R5. Grow this from real Ask/search logs and flagged misses; keep expectations resync-stable (sender/subject substrings, not messageIds).

paraphrase.query: who emailed about a virtual office renewal
note about a credit for a bill
